Use this workflow for the website buttons Preview and Clear.

Production URL path: `cqr-admin-cleanup-v1`

Apps Script property:
`CQR_N8N_CLEANUP_WEBHOOK_URL`

Input keys expected: `target_game_code`, `target_month`, `run_id` or `cleanup_hash`, `confirm_delete`.

parameters.content:
DELETE ENABLED V5 SAFETY

V5 can target old rows by run_id OR cleanup_hash.

Use steps:
1) confirm_delete = NO -> Preview only.
2) Review master_rows_to_delete_by_tab and central_rows_to_delete_by_tab.
3) confirm_delete = YES -> delete only matched rows.
4) Rows are grouped bottom-to-top per sheet.
5) Prefer cleanup_hash when Central/DataIndex shows old hash but old run_id is unclear.

nodes.name: IF Confirm Delete YES
nodes.notes: Safety gate: only TRUE branch prepares delete ranges.

  message: 'No matching rows were found. Nothing was deleted. This usually means the old run was already cleaned, or the config does not match existing rows.'
}}];
